company.name: Buró de Ingresos
company.shortDescription: Buró de Ingresos provides an API platform that verifies income, employment and economic activity data for individuals and businesses.
company.description: Buró de Ingresos provides an API-based infrastructure for income verification tailored to financial institutions and other organizations that need to assess income for credit, underwriting or risk decisions. The platform connects to fiscal and payroll data sources to deliver verified information on income, employment and economic activity for both individuals and businesses. For individuals, it returns verified monthly income, payroll history, income type, invoices and stability metrics. For businesses and SMEs, it exposes billing volumes from CFDI invoices, customer concentration, revenue recurrence and invoicing trends. Customers integrate the REST API into their onboarding and credit workflows, using JSON responses and a sandbox environment for testing. Buró de Ingresos emphasizes compliance with Mexican data protection law and requires explicit consent for each verification.
